headings.usage: Use IBM Plex Sans for all page titles, card headers, and modal titles. Do not use Inter or Roboto for headings.

body.usage: Use for primary body text, form labels, and table data. Maintain dense sizing.

mono.usage: Use for PO numbers, Document Codes (6-char doc code), Vendor Codes, and monetary values.

visual enhancers.borders: 1px solid #CBD3DB. Use rounded-sm for a corporate structural feel.
visual enhancers.shadows: shadow-sm. Flat UI design typical of modern Enterprise ERPs.

component name.SupplierSignupPage.jsx: External page. Center-aligned card (N0 bg) over an N20 background. Form inputs must be dense with bordered fields. Primary button is #0076CC.
component name.SupplierLoginPage.jsx: External page. Center-aligned, clean, corporate login feel. Add Oracle Alta blue accents.
component name.SupplierPendingPage.jsx: External page. Status screen. Distinct status icon and a utilitarian message box.
component name.SupplierDashboardPage.jsx: External page. Tabular dashboard. Dense data-grid table styling for Open POs and Shipments. Tabs for navigation between sections. Action: Create Shipment modal.
component name.SupplierPortalApprovalsPage.jsx: Internal admin page. Full-width dense data table. Tab-based filtering (Pending, Approved, Rejected). Action buttons should be compact.
component name.GrnApprovalPage.jsx: Internal admin page. Search/lookup bar for 6-char shipment code. Data table for Pending shipments. Action: Approve/Reject shipment.
component name.tables: Border-collapse. Header row with #F5F6F7 background and #5B738B text. Data rows with #FFFFFF, bordered bottom. py-2 px-3 padding.
component name.buttons: Pill-shape not allowed. Stick to rounded-sm. Solid primary #0076CC.
component name.badges: Flat background with colored text (e.g. bg-green-100 text-green-800) and rounded-sm.

grids.columns: 12-column for forms. Tables take full width.

motion.animations: Minimal. Avoid decorative motion in ERP.

accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Apply IBM Plex Sans for headings and body for a structured enterprise look.
Use Oracle Alta UI colors: Brand Base #0076CC, Hover #4DA3E0.
Design dense, information-heavy tables with border-b, minimal padding (py-2), and sticky headers.
Do NOT use rounded-full or heavy shadows; stick to rounded-sm and shadow-sm for utilitarian ERP aesthetic.
Forms should have clear borders (border-[#CBD3DB]), small labels (text-[#5B738B]), and compact inputs.
Tabs should have a bottom border indicator in #0076CC when active.
Use IBM Plex Mono for IDs, Codes, and PO Numbers to align tabular data vertically.
No heavy gradients or glassmorphism. Stick to flat, solid colors.
Do NOT apply universal transitions (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns, overlays, or surfaces containing content.
Add 'data-testid' attributes to all buttons, links, inputs, and functional UI components.
